segments.title: wherdr in one minute
segments.narration: Meet where-der, the web and mobile interface for Herder. Follow your coding agents and steer their work, from your computer or your phone.
segments.caption: Meet wherdr, the web and mobile interface for Herdr. Follow your coding agents and steer their work, from your computer or your phone.

segments.title: Your agents, across machines
segments.narration: See your agents across machines in one place. Spot who is working, who has finished, and who needs your attention. Open an agent to pick up the conversation.
segments.caption: See your agents across machines in one place. Spot who is working, who has finished, and who needs your attention. Open an agent to pick up the conversation.

segments.title: Read. Reply. Keep moving.
segments.narration: Read a clear conversation, with the agent's updates and questions together. Send a reply to give direction and keep the work moving, without digging through terminal output.
segments.caption: Read a clear conversation, with the agent's updates and questions together. Send a reply to give direction and keep the work moving, without digging through terminal output.

segments.title: The terminal is right here
segments.narration: Need the full picture? Switch to the terminal for a direct view of the same agent, right inside where-der.
segments.caption: Need the full picture? Switch to the terminal for a direct view of the same agent, right inside wherdr.

segments.title: The same work, on your phone
segments.narration: Away from your desk? Open where-der on your phone to check progress, read an update, and answer when an agent needs you.
segments.caption: Away from your desk? Open wherdr on your phone to check progress, read an update, and answer when an agent needs you.

segments.title: An optional board from herdr-projects
segments.narration: Using herder-projects? where-der gives you a simple view of its board, tasks, and reviews. The board is optional: where-der works with Herder alone, too.
segments.caption: Using herdr-projects? wherdr gives you a simple view of its board, tasks, and reviews. The board is optional: wherdr works with Herdr alone, too.
